name: DfaScanner::scan / any_match

test_list.description: One scan over a haystack containing three different rule hits reports all three with their rule ids.
Spans are exact byte offsets of each match.
Ordinary prose and code produce no match and any_match is false.
More matches than the caller's ScanBuf capacity is AutomataError::BufferFull; the buffer never reallocates.
Each rule of the default pack matches a generated positive sample and rejects a look-alike.
Invalid UTF-8 around a secret neither errors nor hides the match.
max_patterns is enforced at build time (TooManyPatterns).
The default compiler limit rejects a 5,000-pattern pack before compiling the automaton.
For random haystacks, matches equal the regex crate's leftmost-first find_iter over the alternation of the same patterns.

output_description: Number of matches written (leftmost-first, non-overlapping, ordered).
